macros.name: WithArrowsNewStyle
macros.doc: The extension witharrows provides a command \WithArrowsNewStyle to define styles in a way similar to the “styles” of Tikz.

macros.name: WithArrowsOptions
macros.doc: Almost all the options can also be set at the document level with the command \WithArrowsOptions.

macros.name: WithArrowsRightX
macros.doc: The environments {DispWithArrows} and its starred version {DispWithArrows*} provide a command \WithArrowsRightX which can be used in a definition of tikz-code. This command gives the x-value of the right side of the composition box (taking into account the eventual tags of the equations).

envs.name: WithArrows
envs.doc: The LaTeX package witharrows provides environments {WithArrows} and {DispWithArrows} similar to the environments {aligned} and {align} of amsmath but with the possibility to draw arrows on the right side of the alignment.
